rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, place, or community hit by a disaster.

example.english: This village was stricken by a disaster and still hasn’t returned to normal.
example.traditional: 呢個村受災之後，仲未恢復正常。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cyun1 sau6 zoi1 zi1 hau6 zung6 mei6 fui1 fuk1 zing3 soeng4

rows.traditional: 俾 A 搞到動彈不得
rows.jyutping: bei2 A gaau2 dou3 dung6 taan4 bat1 dak1
rows.note: Use this when something has left someone physically unable to move or function.

example.english: Back pain has left me stricken, unable even to get out of bed.
example.traditional: 我俾腰痛搞到動彈不得，連落床都唔得。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 jiu1 tung3 gaau2 dou3 dung6 taan4 bat1 dak1 lin4 lok6 cong4 dou1 m4 dak1

rows.note: Use this colloquial adjective for someone left disabled or badly impaired, rather than merely temporarily incapacitated.

example.english: After his stroke, he was left stricken and needed help even to walk.
example.traditional: 佢中風之後，成個人殘晒，行路都要人扶。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung1 fung1 zi1 hau6 seng4 go3 jan4 caan4 saai3 haang4 lou6 dou1 jiu3 jan4 fu4
